IMPORT BETS · CSV hitter props

BULK IMPORT. Paste or upload a CSV of bets you placed elsewhere (DraftKings, FanDuel, paper notes). Tool resolves player + game, then auto-grades. Skips duplicates that already exist in your history.
COLUMN EXAMPLE NOTES
date 2025-04-22 or 4/22/2025 required · ISO or US format
player Aaron Judge required · last name fallback OK
prop HR · TB · H · RBI · R · WALKS · SB required · see below
line 0.5 or 1.5 optional · prop-implied default
odds +250 or -120 optional
units 1 or 0.5 optional · default 1
result win · loss · push · (blank) optional · auto-graded if blank
Prop vocabulary: HR (home run), TB (total bases 1.5+), H (1+ hits), HRR (H+R+RBI 1.5+), R (1+ runs), RBI (1+ RBI), SINGLES, WALKS (BB+HBP), SB (1+ steals). DraftKings names like "To Hit a Home Run" or "Total Bases" are auto-mapped.
